Take a character card and help your team to defeat the other ones. Use your character powers to achieve your goal by discovering information about other players, saving or...killing someone! Speak with players publicly or with private messages. Learn to lie to your best friends and, obiously, do not trust anybody. Trusis is available from 5 to 30 players! Try the standard set, with pre-set characters, or have fun trying crazy characters combinations with custom sets. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Goal of the game 2 Gameplay 2.1 Day ☀️ 2.2 Night 🌙 3 Characters 3.1 Human team 3.2 Trusis team 3.3 Castaway team 4 Game setup 4.1 Standard set 4.2 Custom set Goal of the game Human team: Kill all Trusis. Trusis team: Get a majority of Trusis over the other characters (including those on their team) or kill all players from the other teams. Castaway team: Have a member of your team alive when the victory conditions of one of the other teams are met. This will invalidate their victory and Castaway team will win. Gameplay Players can speak publicly or privately at any time of the game. For the success of the game, everyone is advised to actively participate in the discussions to raise suspicions, accuse other players and defend themselves. Players who die during the game are still able to talk, but they will no longer be able to use their special powers. It is prohibited, for the success of the game, to show your role to other players, to encourage someone to do so, or to support this kind of behavior. It is forbidden to send, request, or falsify texts, images, audio, video, and multimedia content present in the game or related to the game (e.g., screenshots of the game, private messages, etc.). It is also prohibited to claim that you have done so. Day ☀️ The game starts with the DAY phase. Each day, all alive player can discuss and vote for another player to kill. Voting is optional and players are allowed to change their votes until they pass. At the end of the phase the player with most votes will die. In case of a tie, no one will die. During the DAY, characters with daily powers will be able to use them. Night 🌙 Each night, any alive Trusis can vote for a player to kill. Voting is optional and Trusis players are allowed to change their votes until they pass. At the end of the phase the player with most votes will die. In case of a tie, no one will die. During the NIGHT, characters with night powers will be able to use them. Characters Human team HUMAN : An ordinary Human with no special powers. SWEEPER : Each night, the Sweeper can select one alive player to see if they are Trusis, Castaway, or neither of them. GRAVEKEEPER : Each night, the Gravekeeper will know if the player who died during the day was a Trusis or not. He doesn't know the role of the players who died after himself. PRIEST : Each night, the Priest can select a player to protect from the Trusis kill during that night. If Trusis chooses to kill the protected player no death occurs that night. WISE WOMAN : During the night, the Wise Woman can select a player to cast an invisible vote for the next day in addition to her normal daytime vote. WHITE KNIGHT : During the day or the night, the White Knight can sacrifice himself to bring a dead player back to life in the next phase. Trusis team TRUSIS : Trusis knows the identity of all other Trusis(s). Each night it can vote for a player to kill. It is recommended for Trusis to coordinate, in order to decide which player to eliminate. BUTCHER : The butcher has a sharp knife and a thirst for blood but no special powers. ILLUSIONIST : During the day, the Illusionist can give two votes: one fake, but visible, and one real but invisible, which is counted for the daily kill. ORACLE : Each night, the Oracle can select an alive player to see their exact role. BLACK KNIGHT : During the day or the night, the Black Knight can sacrifice himself to bring a dead player back to life in the next phase. KAMIKAZE

[Rating: 6/10] Maybe slightly more room for smart plays or something than mafia or werewolf, but you can still run into issues with lacks of information. I do like how the roles seem balanced out for the most part and how the secret voting can impact decisions.

[Rating: 7/10] Mostly fun because of the talking and accusations. It's a social deduction game. Kill the other teams and hope yours survives.

[Rating: 9/10] Played on BGA, Trusis is a nice party game based on Werewolf and similar titles. Talking is essential for the success of the game and since it strongly depends on the players you play with, it may happen to have more/less exciting games.  The set of available characters and related abilities is quite balanced and the possibility to create custom games allows to test unlimited scenarios, varying from more standard to more challenging ones.
